title: Seventh Collected Coin Awards Zero Score
explanation: At frame 429 (t=7.59s), collecting the 7th coin (coin_id: 60699969233) at (3200, 500) resulted in 0 points being awarded. Traced to Coin.gd:L63-L71 where total_coins_collected == 7 overrides should_award_score to false, violating the contract that collectibles award their defined score value.
repro_hint: Collect 7 coins in Map2; the 7th coin picked awards 0 points.
